narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a collaborative social media trend piece featuring several Japanese influencers or residents in Taiwan. They use a recurring musical jingle to share their most memorable or 'unforgettable' Taiwanese foods, ranging from breakfast noodles to late-night ramen and street snacks. The purpose is to entertain and engage viewers through relatable food experiences and high-energy comedic delivery.
